author: synthetic_author_a
title: Synthetic House
text: The shadow crossed the old house and waited beside the mirror at night. The door opened toward a forest where the double carried a wound.

author: synthetic_author_b
title: Synthetic Quest
text: The child crossed the river and entered the forest beyond the threshold. A queen gave a stone to the wanderer before the road disappeared.

author: synthetic_author_c
title: Synthetic Descent
text: Fire, stone, dream, wound, and mask appeared in the underworld vision. The voice of night gathered around the tower.

author: synthetic_author_d
title: Synthetic Crown
text: The king saw blood on the mirror and heard a ghost in the hall. The crown became a mask, and the house became a tomb.

author: synthetic_author_e
title: Synthetic River
text: The mother spoke from the river while birds circled the garden. A child carried the door of the old house across the sea.

author: synthetic_author_f
title: Synthetic Return
text: The warrior followed the road through fire and night. At the threshold, a serpent guarded the stone and the lost queen.

author: synthetic_author_g
title: Synthetic Room
text: The voice in the room broke into fragments. A mirror, a mask, and a wound repeated through the dream of the city.

author: synthetic_author_h
title: Synthetic Forest
text: In the forest, the child met a ghost bird and found a bone beneath the tree. The door opened only after the shadow was named.
